explanation: Point is kinematically allowed: W=1.52 GeV is ~34 MeV above the eta production threshold (M_p+M_η≈1.486 GeV) and inside the EXCLURAD eta-grid range (1.487–2.211 GeV). Q²=0.6 GeV², cosθ*=-0.4, φ*=45° are all within the published CLAS12 η production grid. Because it is very close to threshold, the integration can encounter unphysical phase-space points and trigger NAG d01fce errors (ifail=2) — the README explicitly recommends using scripts/run_exclurad_skip_unphys.sh for near-threshold runs. No parameter correction was needed; input uses the standard eta-channel settings (model 3 / maid2000, full O(α), beam 6.535 GeV, vcut=0.166 GeV², 1 point).
